dialog.translation:
Contempla mi técnica
definitiva... ¡Big Bang
+ Muerte!

dialog.english: He blew himself up!
Is this the end?
Nooooooo!
It's not the end!
It will not end!
We won't let it end!
There's no way we'll let it end!
dialog.translation: ¡No hay manera de que esto acabe!

dialog.english: Not at all!
Because...
Because...
We have...
...tomorrow waiting for us!
What was...
...that?
What happened to the explosion?

The power of the Digivices
contained it!
dialog.translation:
¡El poder de los Digivices
lo contuvo!

dialog.english: So... we won?
Seems like it!

So then... the destruction of the
world...
...Did we stop it?
Yeah!
Heeeeeeey!
You did it!
Yes, we did it.

Man, you guys are really somethin'
else!
You think so?
Truly, thank you.

Oh, there's nothing to really
thank us for...
dialog.translation:
Anda, no hay nada
que agradecer...
